credibility_hierarchy.Level_1: Model Formulation / Mathematical existence of governing differential equations
credibility_hierarchy.Level_2: Numerical Verification / Algorithm convergence, energy conservation, solver correctness
credibility_hierarchy.Level_3: Parameter Calibration / Curve fitting post-hoc with free floating parameters (high confounding risk)
credibility_hierarchy.Level_4: Independent Experimental Validation / Forward prediction with FROZEN locked parameters on unseen load paths
credibility_hierarchy.Level_5: Causal Mechanism Identification / Direct local measurement of internal state variables (phase fraction, local slip)

Fang_2019.finding: Phenomenological macromodel in OpenSees (Steel02 + Self-centering) fits cable hysteresis without resolving micro-contacts. Tested pure axial tension only (RC bridge pier was 1.4m column; cables were unbonded restrainers). Threat: if macromodel matches M-kappa, contact micro-modeling lacks added parsimony value.

Vahidi_2022.finding: 3D Abaqus FEA with Auricchio UMAT using Reedlunn single-wire parameters successfully predicted 1x27 and 7x7 cable tension hysteresis with locked parameters.

Reedlunn_2013.finding: Costello model failure at steep helix angles (>20 deg) resulted from neglecting local wire bending/twisting moments, not failure of NiTi continuum laws. Shallow helix cables closely matched single wire responses. Contact indentations were pre-existing manufacturing artifacts.

Zhang_Yao_2026.finding: Calibrated 3-regime friction model for 700 nylon fibers under positive pressure up to 300 kPa; did not independently measure inter-fiber normal forces.

parameter_origin_summary.compensation_risk: Low if measured independently; high if floated to compensate for slip compliance.
Moderate; easily confounded with plastic slip at large strains.
Extreme; can directly trade off against pressure transmission factor alpha_trans.
Critical; product (mu * alpha_trans) governs slip onset. Indistinguishable in global M-kappa.
Hoop stress absorbs chamber pressure p, causing effective normal force to drop.
Can mimic zero-pressure residual bending stiffness.

confounding_warnings: Global M-kappa curve only constrains the product (mu * alpha_trans * p); individual parameters cannot be uniquely identified.
Double-counting compliance danger: using bundle-measured E_bundle inside contact FEA doubles structural softness.
Superior curve fit achieved by floating parameters is NOT evidence of new physics.
